contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ [GLORIA EXERCITVS] ; D/ [...]INVS IVN NOB C

A copper-alloy nummus of Constantine II. AD330-335, (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Reverse shows Two soldiers, two standards. Mint unknown. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads [...]INVS IVN NOB C. Die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 1.95g, diameter is 16.4mm
